verdict.rationale: E2B's own GitHub README points to a first-party Desktop SDK offering mouse, keyboard, screenshot, application, and desktop streaming APIs, which indicates a full desktop environment inside the sandbox. However, this rests on a single brief mention, with no in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration. Custom templates that could install a browser are only a building block and earn no credit. missing for 10: detailed Desktop SDK documentation, explicit headless browser support, independent or hands-on corroboration of desktop or browser use in the sandbox.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a headless browser or full desktop environment inside the sandbox

citations.quote: For mouse, keyboard, screenshot, application, and desktop streaming APIs, install the Desktop SDK
